components.name: GPU Die (Processing Chip)
components.reasoning: The semiconductor GPU chip is the core processing element fabricated as a discrete silicon die, always procured as a separate unit by board manufacturers from semiconductor fabs.

components.name: GDDR Memory Modules
components.reasoning: High-speed graphics DRAM (GDDR6 or GDDR6X) is supplied as separate memory IC packages soldered onto the GPU card, representing a major procurement category distinct from the GPU die.

components.name: Printed Circuit Board (PCB)
components.reasoning: The multi-layer PCB forms the physical platform for mounting the GPU, memory, power delivery, and other components; it is a distinct manufactured item often custom-produced by PCB fabricators.

components.name: Power Delivery Subsystem (VRM Module)
components.reasoning: Voltage regulator modules (VRMs) converting PSU power to required GPU voltages are critical separate electronics subassemblies mounted on the PCB with their own supply chains.

components.name: Cooling System (Heatsink and Fan Assembly)
components.reasoning: The thermal solution, usually including a metal heatsink and one or multiple fans, is a separate mechanical assembly procured from specialized suppliers to dissipate GPU heat effectively.

components.name: PCIe Interface Connector
components.reasoning: The gold-fingered PCI Express edge connector enables electrical and physical connection to the motherboard; it is a distinct manufactured component integrated into the PCB edge but obtainable separately.

components.name: VRAM Thermal Pads or Spreaders
components.reasoning: Thermal interface materials or aluminum spreaders used on memory modules to assist heat dissipation are often separate components procured and installed during assembly.

components.name: Firmware Storage Module (EEPROM/Flash)
components.reasoning: Non-volatile memory chips storing the GPU card BIOS/firmware are distinct electronic components soldered to the PCB, often procured from different suppliers.

components.name: Display Output Interfaces (HDMI, DisplayPort Modules)
components.reasoning: Dedicated interface modules or ports for video output are procurable components or subassemblies attached to the PCB, sourced separately from specialized connector manufacturers.

Graphics Processor Die.name: Silicon
Graphics Processor Die.reasoning: Silicon is the fundamental semiconductor material used to fabricate the GPU die, absolutely essential as the base substrate for all transistor and circuit structures with no substitutes in mainstream GPUs.

Graphics Processor Die.name: Copper
Graphics Processor Die.reasoning: Copper is widely used for interconnects within the die for signal and power distribution due to its excellent electrical conductivity.

Graphics Processor Die.name: Aluminum
Graphics Processor Die.reasoning: Aluminum is commonly used for metal layers and bonding pads on the GPU die for electrical contacts and wiring, industry standard though copper has partially replaced it.

Graphics Processor Die.name: Tungsten
Graphics Processor Die.reasoning: Tungsten serves as contact plugs and vias in semiconductor processing, commonly used though alternatives exist in some processes.

Graphics Processor Die.name: Titanium
Graphics Processor Die.reasoning: Titanium is used for adhesion layers or barrier metals in semiconductor fabrication, common but alternatives like tantalum may be used.

Gpu.name: Silicon
Gpu.reasoning: Silicon forms the core semiconductor in the GPU chip, absolutely essential for device operation.

Gpu.name: Copper
Gpu.reasoning: Copper is essential for internal wiring and heat dissipation components in the GPU module, standard material for electrical conduction.

Gpu.name: Aluminum
Gpu.reasoning: Aluminum is used in casing, heat spreaders, and some connections in GPU assemblies, very common and standard.

Main Board.name: Copper
Main Board.reasoning: Copper is essential as the primary conductor for printed circuit board traces, universal across all main boards.

Main Board.name: Fiberglass
Main Board.reasoning: Fiberglass is the base substrate material for most PCBs providing structural and insulating properties, industry standard.

Main Board.name: Epoxy resins
Main Board.reasoning: Epoxy resins bind the fiberglass layers and form the PCB core material, critical for board integrity and insulation.

Main Board.name: Tin
Main Board.reasoning: Tin is used in solder alloys and surface finishes for component attachment, standard in electronics assembly.

Main Board.name: Silver
Main Board.reasoning: Silver is sometimes used for high-performance conductive inks and plating, less common but important in specialty boards.

Gddr Memory Modules.reasoning: Fiberglass forms the PCB substrate for GDDR memory modules, standard and critical for structure and insulation.

Gddr Memory Modules.name: Epoxy resins
